image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey Cafe Amazon coffee shop building, detailed front elevation with a glazed frontage and glass door under a deep green fascia carrying the yellow-green Cafe Amazon wordmark and parrot device on a backlit sign, timber slat cladding below the window sill and a slim timber-edged canopy, plain warm cream painted side and rear walls in a single flat off-white tone clearly lighter than the background, with a service door, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: forest green painted panel timber slats and backlit acrylic sign face at the front, plate glass, flat warm cream painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless MID-DARK neutral grey (#606060), distinctly darker than every part of the building so the object reads as a clean cut-out against it. The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: Cafe Amazon / OR. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93 on the owner's layout: three-pane glazing to the corner, full-width ledge, centred logo, side window. 2152/16000 triangles, 11/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 11/16 unique geometries, 5 textures, factory ~65 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m as declared: wall 7.44 m wide plus the canopy's 0.46 m -X overhang, canopy nose at z 3.45, and the canopy now runs the WHOLE front (x -3.96..3.97) with a timber edge board at both ends. check-coplanar clean at 0.001 m. Hand 8-box compound re-measured with the widened canopy box: coverage 0.9897, overshoot 0.0059, p95 0.049 m.
featureReviews.notes: Fourth build, owner layout over the plate: 'the ledge at the top needs to extend across the entire front'. Massing unchanged.

featureReviews.evidence: One full-width sign board (x -3.49..3.97, y 3.0..4.5) sampling a strip rebaked for its 7.46 m width (scratch/_ca/bake_sign.py v4, composed at 400 px/m on 2984 x 600 and squashed to the 2048 x 280 band): badge 1.05 m at world -1.23 and the 2.79 m wordmark from -0.60 to 2.19, so the 3.99 m group is CENTRED on the board at x 0.24. Front render shows badge and wordmark centred on the band.
featureReviews.notes: Owner review: 'the logo should be centred at the top'. The plate hangs it left; the build follows the owner.

featureReviews.evidence: The green is one band the same 1.5 m depth across the whole front, wrapping +X as a 0.55 m return 12 cm proud of the side wall, plus the -X pilaster. Three boards on one baked strip: one material, one draw call.
featureReviews.notes: The plate's deep right-bay block, corner window and 0.87 m pilaster are deliberately not built: with the glazing running to the corner under a uniform ledge, the band is uniform too.

featureReviews.evidence: Glass door 0.92 m on a hinge at -3.02 with a transom, then ONE run of three equal 1.92 m panes from the latch jamb (-2.02) to a corner stile at 3.75 (mullions at -0.10 and 1.83), head 2.55 throughout; plain chroma-held glazing tint as the third build. Turntable passed at every azimuth.
featureReviews.notes: Owner review: 'the front window is 3 panes and needs to extend across the whole front'. The third build's two-mullion left run, pilaster and 2.20 m corner window are replaced.

featureReviews.evidence: 23 batten courses in three runs; the +X return now runs 2.8 m along the side under the new window. Canopy slab pale blue-grey with 0.12 m timber edge boards at the nose and BOTH ends, full width.
featureReviews.notes: Unchanged tones; 73 boxes, one draw call.

featureReviews.evidence: +X wall: a 2.3 x 1.5 m black-framed two-pane window 0.25..2.55 m behind the front corner (sill 1.05, head 2.55, one mullion) over the batten dado, and the cream service door 1.0 x 2.25 m at 4.0..5.0 m recessed 0.12 m with its reveal and lever.
featureReviews.notes: Owner review: 'the side of the building needs a larger window'. The third build's 0.55 m corner return was the only side glazing.

featureReviews.evidence: Three instanced split condensers at 1.3 scale along the rear upstand, unchanged.
